source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: DeepSeek重启融资 投前估值5000亿元
topics.official_english: DeepSeek resumes fundraising at 500 billion yuan pre-money valuation
topics.why_hot: A leading Chinese AI startup raising new capital at a reported 500 billion yuan valuation shows how much investor confidence remains in the country's large-model race.
topics.share_angle: Explain what a pre-money valuation means and use DeepSeek as a window into China's AI funding boom.

topics.chinese_topic: 多地出新政“抢”3.2亿老年人
topics.official_english: Local governments roll out new policies to attract and serve China's 320 million elderly
topics.why_hot: With 320 million elderly citizens, local governments across China are competing through new policies to improve elderly care and tap into the silver economy.
topics.share_angle: Frame aging as a policy opportunity rather than a burden, and highlight the social and economic innovations behind the 'talent war' for retirees.

topics.chinese_topic: 创新药凭什么成中国新名片
topics.official_english: Why innovative drugs are becoming China's new calling card
topics.why_hot: China's biopharmaceutical industry is increasingly known for original R&D instead of generics, making innovative drugs a source of national pride and economic focus.
topics.share_angle: Break down the pipeline from lab to market and explain how policy, capital, and talent are turning drugs into an export-grade business card.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风白海豚体型堪比东北三省
topics.official_english: Typhoon Dolphin's size is comparable to China's three northeastern provinces
topics.why_hot: A vivid size comparison helps people grasp a typhoon's massive footprint and raises awareness about storm preparation.
topics.share_angle: Use the size comparison as a science-communication hook to teach how typhoons are measured and how to read official warnings.

topics.chinese_topic: 多中国游客被拒登机 泰国机场致歉
topics.official_english: Thai airport apologizes after Chinese tourists denied boarding
topics.why_hot: A consumer-rights dispute abroad quickly resonates with Chinese travelers and raises questions about airport and airline service standards.
topics.share_angle: Explain what travelers can do when denied boarding and why destination apologies matter for tourism relations.

topics.chinese_topic: 亲人离世家人不知存款在哪 怎么办
topics.official_english: What to do when a relative dies and family members cannot find their bank savings
topics.why_hot: Many families face the practical and emotional problem of locating a deceased relative's assets, especially in the digital banking age.
topics.share_angle: Provide a clear public-service explainer on legal procedures for inheriting and withdrawing deposits when account details are unknown.

topics.chinese_topic: 女子带10岁儿子从成都坐火车去意大利
topics.official_english: Woman travels by train from Chengdu to Italy with her 10-year-old son
topics.why_hot: An adventurous mother-and-son rail journey across Eurasia inspires curiosity about long-distance train travel and alternative ways to see the world.
topics.share_angle: Map the possible route and discuss how slow travel can be an educational experience for children.

topics.chinese_topic: 你家楼下的兰州拉面要改名字了
topics.official_english: The Lanzhou lamian restaurant near you may be getting a name change
topics.why_hot: An everyday Chinese food brand that feels like a neighborhood institution is reportedly changing its name, sparking nostalgia and curiosity.
topics.share_angle: Use the rename to explain how regional food brands build identity and what changes when a generic name becomes a formal brand.
